_meta.title: 八个人，四十句
_meta.eyebrow: Many Faces of Sam · 台词改稿 第一批
_meta.lede: 体检里分数最低的那八位，五句全部重写过一遍。每一句都得先过移植测试——这话放到别人身上还成立吗？成立就作废重写。新句子全长在他自己的东西上：一件道具、一个动作、一句原片台词，或是他 AU 正文里已经有的那件事。
howto: 下面一人一块，五句按顺序排。淡的是旧的，亮的是新的，最底下那行小字写着这句料是从哪儿挖出来的。
第 ① 句叫「锚句」，它同时印在画册、光谱、测验三个地方——所以改它动静大一点。其中四位的锚句我建议换掉，都标了红牌。
你看完挑：哪几句留、哪几句不要、哪几句想换个说法。不用一条条回，把不喜欢的点出来就行。
_meta.ask_lede: 都是凭喜好判断的事，不涉及技术，你挑完我就落地。

forks.h: 那四句锚句，换还是不换？
forks.p: Victor、Eddie、Samuel、Brad Cairn 的第 ① 句我都换了——旧的那四句都是「你是唯一看见我的人」这一类，谁说都成立。但锚句同时是画册上那句铭文，换了画册那一页也跟着变。
opts: A　四句都换（我建议这个，旧的那四句实在太泛）
B　只换 Samuel 那句（他漏了「唱得很烂的驻唱」这个本行，漏得最离谱）
C　锚句一律不动，只改第 ②–⑤ 句

forks.h: Brad Cairn 要不要留在这一批？
forks.p: 他是全站分数最低的（0.5），可他在《约书亚》里是个有老婆孩子、正被儿子一点点毁掉的爸爸。我把他写成了「那个在哭声和钢琴声中间撑着的人」，没碰孩子那条线。
opts: B　先撤掉，等哪天真给他写 AU 再一起长
C　留着，但你说个方向我重写

forks.h: 新句子普遍比旧的「冷」，这个方向对吗？
forks.p: 旧句子爱直说心里话（「你是唯一」「我想变好」）；新句子多半只摆一件具体的东西，让你自己感觉到——比如 Trent 那句不说想你，只说「铺底下那个咖啡罐，最近我是按两个人算的」。
opts: A　就要这个，摆东西比表白好看
B　太克制了，有些人（比如 Buck、Eddie）我想听他把话说出口
C　一半一半：每人留一两句直白的

_meta.foot: 这一版只是稿子，一个字都还没上线。你点头之后我才写进台词库，顺带把画册 / 光谱 / 测验那三处的锚句一起同步，再跑一遍全站校验。标题（那行全大写的小字）会印在桌面小组件和每日一句上，所以每一个都查过：全站不重名，同一个人的五条之间也不互相包含。

quotes.label: LOSE CLEAN, NOT DIRTY
quotes.line: I'd rather lose clean than win dirty.
quotes.lineCN: 宁可干干净净地输，也不脏着赢。
quotes.src: 原片高光台词（句子没动，只换了标题：原来那个 OFF THE CLOCK 跟这句不沾边）

quotes.label: THE LAST NAME ON THE ENVELOPE
quotes.line: Every name on that envelope has been crossed out by somebody. Mine is the last one. I'm not passing it on.
quotes.lineCN: 那只信封上的名字，一个个都被人划掉了。我的是最后一个。我不往下传了。
quotes.src: Interoffice 母题①：缠红线绳的内部信封，面单上一格格划掉的历任收件人

quotes.label: TWO WEEKS OF DONUTS
quotes.line: Two weeks I brought a different donut every morning and broke off a corner for you, never asking, just watching your face. Now it's always chocolate, and the big half is always yours.
quotes.lineCN: 有两个星期，我每天早上换一种甜甜圈，掰一角给你，从不问，只看你的脸。现在永远是巧克力——大的那半，永远归你。
quotes.src: Interoffice 母题②：巧克力甜甜圈（他从不问、只记你的表情；大的那半永远归你）

quotes.label: NUMBERED IN PENCIL
quotes.line: You number my notes in pencil on the back. Fiftieth one, by that morning. I write them so the number keeps going up.
quotes.lineCN: 你在我每张条子背面用铅笔编号。到那天早上，第五十张。我天天写，就为了那个数字一直往上走。
quotes.src: Interoffice 母题⑤：铁盒 + 你用铅笔写的编号（Winter 点名喜欢的细节）

quotes.label: CAN'T FIRE ME, I QUIT
quotes.line: They can't fire me. I quit. Took me twenty-two years to learn to say it first — and I said it for you.
quotes.lineCN: 他们开不了我，我辞了。我用二十二年才学会抢在前头说这句话——而我是为你说的。
quotes.src: 原片第二高光台词 You can't fire me, 'cause I quit.

quotes.label: SAVING UP TO TAKE YOU
quotes.line: I was saving up to leave. Now I'm saving up to take you with me.
quotes.lineCN: 我攒钱本是为了离开——如今攒钱，是为了带你一起走。
quotes.src: 系列落点，句子不动；只把标题从 ON THE ROAD OUT 换成指事的

quotes.label: A CUP FROM THE CUPBOARD
quotes.line: Every house on this street leaves my cup out on the step. You took one down from the cupboard and put it in my hand.
quotes.lineCN: 这条街上每一家，都把我那只杯子搁在台阶上。你从柜子里拿了一只，放进我手里。
quotes.src: 系列母题②「两只杯子」＋ Ch1 原话「台阶上那杯是给我的」

quotes.label: THE MAN IN THE BOOTH
quotes.line: The gate goes up for you and down for me, and the man in the booth writes my name every single time. Inside the wall, you're the only one who ever says it out loud.
quotes.lineCN: 那道门对你抬起来，对我落下去，门房每一回都要把我的名字登记一遍。墙里头，只有你把它念出声过。
quotes.src: 系列母题④：Camelot Gardens 那道铁门＋门房登记

quotes.label: NINE FEET DEEP
quotes.line: Thirty feet down, nine feet deep, four and a half over the east ledge. I counted all of it. They call it showing off. You're the only one who ever called it knowing what I'm doing.
quotes.lineCN: 三十英尺高，九英尺深，东边那道石梁四英尺半。我全数过。他们管这叫逞能——只有你说，那叫心里有数。
quotes.src: 系列母题①「三十英尺那一跳」（他的野其实是本事）

quotes.label: SHAKE THE COFFEE CAN
quotes.line: There's a coffee can under the bunk. Shake it and you can hear how far off August is. Lately I've been counting it for two.
quotes.lineCN: 铺底下有个咖啡罐。摇一摇，就听得出八月还有多远。最近我是按两个人算的。
quotes.src: 系列母题⑤：攒钱的咖啡铁罐「八月，再割六个礼拜就够了」

quotes.label: AFTER CLOSING, 1734
quotes.line: I spend all day in 1734, telling strangers to mind the pox. You're the only one who ever waited around to hear what I sound like after closing.
quotes.lineCN: 我整天活在 1734 年，叮嘱游客当心天花。你是唯一一个，肯留下来听听我下了班是什么声音的人。
quotes.src: Choke Point 的世界：殖民主题公园的群演（⚠️ 换了锚句，画册铭文会跟着变）

quotes.label: YOU NEVER SAVED ME
quotes.line: The trick is you have to let them save you. They send money for years afterward. You looked at me across a table and didn't save me once — that's why I kept coming back.
quotes.lineCN: 诀窍是得让他们救成。之后他们会寄好几年的钱。你隔着一张桌子看着我，一次也没救过我——所以我才一趟趟地回来。
quotes.src: 原片的金矿「假装噎住让陌生人来救」——报告说只挖了一句，这回挖到底

quotes.label: A WORK ISN'T ALLOWED AN OPINION
quotes.line: She called me her work. Nobody tells you a work isn't allowed to have an opinion. You asked me what I thought, and I had to go looking for it.
quotes.lineCN: 她说我是她的作品。没人告诉过我，作品是不许有意见的。你问我怎么想——我得去找一找才找得到。
quotes.src: Ch3《作品》：母亲 Ida 那条线

quotes.label: I FORGOT MY LINE
quotes.line: Everybody in that village is playing somebody. I just happen to do it best. Then you walked through and I forgot my line.
quotes.lineCN: 那个村子里每个人都在演别人。我只是碰巧演得最好的那个。然后你穿过来，我忘词了。
quotes.src: Ch1 原话＋Ch4《卡壳》

quotes.label: PULLING THE SET DOWN
quotes.line: Everyone claps and goes home. You came up on the stage and started pulling the set down with your hands.
quotes.lineCN: 所有人鼓完掌就回家了。你却走上台来，动手把布景一块块拆了。
quotes.src: Ch5《拆台》

quotes.label: OFF THE DISHES, ON A PLANE
quotes.line: Parole says stay in the state, wash your dishes, keep your head down. I got on a plane for a stone I'd never seen. Go on — ask me if I'd do it again.
quotes.lineCN: 假释的规矩是别出州、洗你的盘子、别惹事。我为了一颗从没见过的石头上了飞机。你问啊——问我会不会再来一次。
quotes.src: 《蓝蜥蜴》本体：假释期在小馆子打工，被雇去伦敦（⚠️ 换了锚句）

quotes.label: UP IN THE NEXT PANEL
quotes.line: I read comics on my break, because in those the guy who takes the beating gets up in the next panel. You're the first thing that made me want to be the one drawing it.
quotes.lineCN: 休息的时候我看漫画——在那里面，挨揍的那个下一格就会站起来。你是第一样，让我想当那个画画的人的东西。
quotes.src: 原片给过特写的道具：Eddie 的漫画书

quotes.label: THE BELL OVER THE DOOR
quotes.line: Two years I wiped the same counter, and the bell over that door never meant a thing. Then it went off and it was you. It's meant something ever since.
quotes.lineCN: 两年里我擦同一张台面，门上那只铃响了也不代表什么。直到有一回它响了，是你——从那以后它就有意思了。
quotes.src: 原片场景：纽约那家小馆子

quotes.label: NEXT TO THE STONE
quotes.line: They all wanted the stone. Blue, cold, worth more than my whole life put together. I spent the entire job looking at the thing standing next to it.
quotes.lineCN: 他们都想要那颗石头。蓝的，凉的，比我整条命加起来都值钱。整桩活儿我都在看旁边站着的那个。
quotes.src: 片名那颗蓝钻

quotes.label: FURTHER THAN JERSEY
quotes.line: I'd never been further than Jersey. I crossed an ocean for a job I was going to botch anyway. Turns out I crossed it for you.
quotes.lineCN: 我这辈子最远只到过泽西。为了一桩我横竖要搞砸的活儿，我跨了一整片海。原来我是为你跨的。
quotes.src: 纽约 → 伦敦那一趟

quotes.label: THE ONLY ONE WHO CLAPPED
quotes.line: We're a lounge act. We are not good. I have watched an entire room order food during our set. You clapped, and I have never gotten over it.
quotes.lineCN: 我们是驻唱二人组。唱得不好。我见过整个厅在我们唱的时候点菜。只有你鼓了掌——这件事我到现在没缓过来。
quotes.src: ⚠️ 全站最大的一处漏：他本行是唱得很烂的驻唱，旧的五句一个字都没提（换了锚句）

quotes.label: NEVER OPENED ONE
quotes.line: They think I can open anything with a steel door on it. I have never opened one in my life. You're the only person I've said that to, and you didn't leave.
quotes.lineCN: 他们以为只要是铁门我都打得开。我这辈子一扇都没打开过。这话我只跟你说过——你没走。
quotes.src: 全片的误会：被黑帮当成开保险箱高手

quotes.label: NOT THE CUP
quotes.line: Two grown men with guns fought over a boy's bar mitzvah cup, and I nearly died for it. Afterwards I worked out what I'd actually want in a safe. It was not the cup.
quotes.lineCN: 两个带枪的成年人为一只男孩成年礼的杯子打起来，我差点为它送命。后来我想明白了，保险箱里我真正想放的东西——不是杯子。
quotes.src: 原片的麦高芬：那只 bar mitzvah 杯子

quotes.label: THE ONE WE DON'T BOTCH
quotes.line: There's one song we don't botch. I've been holding it back for a room worth ruining it in. Sit anywhere you like. I'll ruin it for you.
quotes.lineCN: 有一首我们不会唱砸。我一直留着，等一个值得把它唱砸的厅。你随便坐。我为你唱砸它。
quotes.src: 唱歌那条线，第二次出手

quotes.label: FIRST TRY IN PROVIDENCE
quotes.line: Nothing in Providence has ever gone right for me on the first try. You did. That's the only reason I still think this town might be all right.
quotes.lineCN: 在普罗维登斯，我没有一件事是一次就做对的。除了你。就因为这个，我才老觉得这镇子说不定还行。
quotes.src: 故事发生地（罗德岛的普罗维登斯，不是别处）

quotes.label: PROVE THEM WRONG ABOUT YOU
quotes.line: I won't say 'I love you' — too cheap. I'll just prove they were wrong about you.
quotes.lineCN: 我不说「我爱你」——太廉价。我只会逐条证明：他们看错了你。
quotes.src: 句子不动（很他），只把标题从 OFF THE RECORD 换成指事的

quotes.label: BOXES NOBODY OPENED
quotes.line: I sat in a federal basement for weeks going through boxes nobody had ever opened. I have never wanted to find anything as badly as I want to keep this.
quotes.lineCN: 我在联邦档案的地下室里坐了好几个星期，翻那些没人打开过的箱子。我这辈子想找到什么东西，都没有像现在想守住这个这么厉害。
quotes.src: 原片：他一个人泡在档案里挖材料

quotes.label: FOUR MINUTES OF TAPE
quotes.line: One tape. Four minutes of a man forgetting the room was listening. That's all it takes to turn everything over — which is why I weigh every single thing I say to you.
quotes.lineCN: 一盘带子。四分钟，一个人忘了整个屋子在听。掀翻一切只需要这么多——所以我对你说的每一个字，都是掂量过的。
quotes.src: 他挖出来的那盘录音带（全片的关键）

quotes.label: THE TRIAL HE NEVER HAD
quotes.line: I wanted to give that man the trial he never had. What I want to give you is the opposite of a trial — one place where you never have to account for anything.
quotes.lineCN: 我想给那个人一场他从未受过的审判。而我想给你的恰恰相反——一个地方，在那里你什么都不必交代。
quotes.src: 他在片里最有名的那句话，翻了个面

quotes.label: NOT ON THE LIST
quotes.line: I keep a legal pad of things people should be made to answer for. Your name isn't on it and it never will be. That list is the only promise I've got to give.
quotes.lineCN: 我有一整本黄稿纸，写满了该有人出来交代的事。上面没有你的名字，永远不会有。那张单子，是我唯一拿得出手的承诺。
quotes.src: 调查记者的黄稿纸

quotes.label: THIS ONE'S YOURS NOW
quotes.line: Here. This one's my favorite. It's yours now.
quotes.lineCN: 给你。这个我最喜欢——现在归你了。
quotes.src: 句子不动（很他），只把标题换成他的原话

quotes.label: THE ONE I WANT TO KEEP
quotes.line: I give away everything I find. You're the one thing I want to keep.
quotes.lineCN: 我捡到什么都送人。只有你，是我想留下的。
quotes.src: 句子不动（送人 vs 留下＝他的全部），标题指事化

quotes.label: HOLES IN THE LID
quotes.line: Punch a few holes in the lid and you can keep a whole night inside a jar. There's one on my shelf I saved from before I met you. It was always going to be yours.
quotes.lineCN: 在盖子上戳几个洞，一整个晚上就装得进一只罐子。我架子上留着一罐，比认识你还早。它本来就该是你的。
quotes.src: 片名 Box of Moonlight 的本体：一罐萤火虫

quotes.label: WHERE'S THE REST OF IT
quotes.line: Half a trailer, no roof over the back end, and I call it a house. You walked in and never asked where the rest of it went.
quotes.lineCN: 半截拖车，后半边连顶都没有，我管它叫房子。你走进来，没问剩下那半边去哪儿了。
quotes.src: 原片：他住的那截拖车残骸

quotes.label: EARLY TO THE CREEK
quotes.line: I don't own a clock and I've never been late for anything in my life. Except last week I got down to the creek early every single day, in case you came by.
quotes.lineCN: 我没有钟，这辈子也没迟到过。就是上礼拜我天天提早到小河边——怕你万一来。
quotes.src: 他的自由，头一回被一个人扭了向

quotes.label: NINETEEN NIGHTS OF SCALES
quotes.line: The baby cried nineteen nights straight, and the boy played scales through every one of them. You're the first quiet I've had that didn't feel like something was wrong.
quotes.lineCN: 那孩子连着哭了十九夜，我儿子就在哭声里一遍遍地弹音阶。你是我第一次遇上的安静，而且不像是出了什么事。
quotes.src: 《约书亚》的房子：哭不停的妹妹 Lily ＋ 弹钢琴的哥哥（⚠️ 换了锚句）

quotes.label: OFF-KEY IN THE KITCHEN
quotes.line: He plays it perfectly and it sounds like nothing at all. You hummed something off-key in my kitchen and I had to sit down.
quotes.lineCN: 他弹得一个错音都没有，听着却什么也不是。你在我厨房里跑调哼了两句，我得坐下来缓一缓。
quotes.src: 钢琴神童儿子的对照面

quotes.label: THE SHIRT AT THE OFFICE
quotes.line: I kept a clean shirt at the office so nobody would work out I'd slept there. You're the only person who ever asked why there was a shirt.
quotes.lineCN: 我在办公室放了件干净衬衫，好让人看不出我在那儿过的夜。只有你问过一句：那件衬衫是干什么的。
quotes.src: 曼哈顿上班的那个爸爸，正在一点点垮掉

quotes.label: OTHER PEOPLE'S MONEY
quotes.line: I move other people's money all day and I'm good at it. I have never once fixed anything that actually mattered. You let me carry something anyway.
quotes.lineCN: 我整天替别人搬钱，而且搬得很好。可真正要紧的事，我一件都没修好过。你还是让我扛了一样。
quotes.src: 他的职业＋全片的无力感

quotes.label: UP AND DOWN THE HALL
quotes.line: I walked that baby up and down the hall till four in the morning, and I'd do it again tonight. Nobody's ever walked me anywhere. You did, once. I haven't stopped thinking about it.
quotes.lineCN: 我抱着那个孩子在走廊里来回走到凌晨四点，今晚再来一次我也走。可从没人这样陪我走过。你陪过一回，我到现在还在想。
quotes.src: 原片里他半夜抱女儿的那些镜头
